name: Transportation Almanac
description: An open, versioned index of public transportation data.

entries.title: UK Road Traffic Statistics (Department for Transport)
entries.description: The Department for Transport's road traffic estimates for Great Britain — vehicle miles by vehicle type and road class, and street-level annual average daily flows and raw counts at count points — with downloads and an API.

coverage.spatial: Great Britain (regions, local authorities, count points)
coverage.temporal: 1993-present (national time series shown on the site)

entries.license: OGL-UK-3.0 (Open Government Licence v3.0, except where otherwise stated)
entries.attribution: Department for Transport, Road traffic statistics
entries.notes: Human-verified 2026-10-31: HTTP 200. The page shows a national time series back to 1993 and offers downloads of "street-level traffic figures for all regions, local authorities and count point locations", including annual average daily flow (overall and by direction) and raw counts. It links an API and states "All content is available under the Open Government Licence v3.0, except where otherwise stated". Coverage is Great Britain, not Northern Ireland. Two things come from DfT's usual practice and weren't checked: the annual cadence and the csv format. The DfT publisher name is taken from the service's own branding.

entries.title: UNCTADstat
entries.description: UN Trade and Development's statistical database covering maritime transport, merchant fleets, liner shipping connectivity, and freight volumes alongside its broader trade and economy indicators.
entries.publisher: United Nations Conference on Trade and Development (UNCTAD)
entries.notes: Verified reachable this session (HTTP 200). ITF-OECD (International Transport Forum), the other natural international transport-statistics body, returned a Cloudflare bot-challenge on direct fetch — same block class as almanac-template#2. Seeded as this vertical's first international (non-US) source per operator request to seed the new verticals international-first.
